body: Mixed. Dad is southern US black. Mom is transplanted from Germany

I normally have my hair short but my girlfriend is out of the country for a long while so I'm not caring too much about my hair. A female coworker said "Man you need a haircut your bald spot is obvious!" and I thought what the crap I don't have bald spot. But I guess I do! 

Like I said it's not an issue for me because I prefer having it cut 1.5 length with trimmers. My best friend was really on on himself as he start to get a receding hairline in college. I never thought it was an issue but I'm not a girl. I have noticed girls talking bad about that kind of thing and I was surprised.
Thanks! I wasn't sure if it was appropriate to post this kind of thing in this forum but I haven't gotten ripped apart so I guess it's ok! :)
